spans.operation: drop every case with a missing rater1 or rater2 score before any analysis
average the two raters into a single continuous skin-tone score, computed once in Excel and recomputed identically in SPSS
binarize RateAve at the lowest possible cut (only a perfect 1 counts as 0) into scenario S1, then test mean redCards across this split
binarize RateAve at a <2 cutoff into scenario S2 and test mean redCards across the split
binarize RateAve at a <3 cutoff into scenario S3 and test mean redCards across the split
binarize RateAve at a <4 cutoff into scenario S4 and test mean redCards across the split
binarize RateAve at a <5 cutoff into scenario S5 and test mean redCards across the split
recode RateAve into a 3-level scenario S6 (exactly 1 / under 3 / otherwise), test mean redCards across the groups, and follow up with SNK, Tukey and LSD pairwise comparisons at alpha .05
pull in the full coded, missing-deleted crowdstorming sheet as the analysis dataset, reading the full cell range with the header row as variable names
collapse the row-level data to one record per player, summing games and red cards and averaging RateAve within player
build a per-game red-card rate by dividing summed red cards by summed games plus one, then test it against the S1 and S2 splits only
mean-center each predictor by subtracting a fixed constant (the sample mean computed earlier) rather than centering dynamically
form two centered interaction terms (implicit bias x rater score, explicit bias x rater score) to test moderation
choose which regression output to report: means/SDs/correlation matrix with significance plus coefficients, 95% CIs, R, ANOVA table, collinearity diagnostics and R-squared change
fit an OLS regression with raw redCards (not the aggregated or rate version) as the outcome
exclude any case with missing data on any regression variable (listwise) rather than pairwise or imputed
set variable-entry/removal significance thresholds and CI width for the regression procedure
keep the regression intercept rather than forcing the line through the origin
enter game-count, win-count and playing-position dummies as the first control block before any bias measures
add referee rater score as its own block, isolating its main effect from the controls
add implicit and explicit bias measures as a third block after the controls and main rater effect
add the two bias-by-rater interaction terms last to test moderation over and above the main effects
request a Durbin-Watson statistic to check residual autocorrelation
flag cases as outliers when their standardized residual exceeds 3 SD
save Mahalanobis distance and covariance/influence diagnostics as case-level variables
